touches.claim: Fraction of radiotracer-labeled phosphorus mobilized from mineral soil by mycorrhizal hyphae that reaches host plant roots within 72 hours, measured under field-comparable pot conditions.

quote_candidates.quote: The large grove-forming ectomycorrhizal tropical tree Microberlinia bisulcata displays strong mast fruiting on poor soils.
Fallen-leaf phosphorus concentration increased in the inter-mast interval, and that for potassium peaked mid-interval.
A drier dry season prior to masting may have increased tree carbon, while a wetter one increased nutrient uptake by roots and mycorrhizas.
Synchrony across masting trees may be enhanced by equilibration of nutrients across the mycorrhizal-root network.
